channel.title: America After Dark with Dudley Duke
channel.description: Three unhurried hours of overnight talk radio, weeknights midnight to 3 AM Eastern from DeLand, Florida. Dudley Duke opens with the real news of the night — state, national and international — then the phones open to callers from across America and around the world. Every night closes with Radio Graffiti, where each caller gets one line, and one line only. Listen live at americaafterdarkradio.com.
channel.itunes:author: Dudley Duke

item.title: Sunday Night, November 8, 2026
item.description: The Sunday night show, aired Monday, November 9, 2026, 12:00–3:00 AM Eastern from DeLand, Florida. The night's real news: Alaska's Senate race sits 637 votes apart with three quarters counted; Democrats sweep Texas statewide; Colorado voters approve public-lands funding; Amy Acton is Ohio's governor-elect; a deadly shooting in Krakow, Poland; strikes in the Strait of Hormuz; Paraguay's former president charged and detained; Pope Leo XIV on the Uruguay-Argentina border. Plus callers from across America and around the world, and Radio Graffiti to close.

item.title: Saturday Night, November 7, 2026
item.description: The Saturday night show, aired Sunday, November 8, 2026, 12:00–3:00 AM Eastern from DeLand, Florida. The night's real news: Keisha Lance Bottoms elected Georgia's first woman governor and the first Black woman elected governor of a U.S. state; Chris Pappas becomes the first openly gay man elected to the U.S. Senate; the Justice Department drops its California ballot suit; Pope Leo XIV celebrates Mass before 40,000 in Paysandu, Uruguay; airstrikes near Sanaa kill at least 27 in Yemen. Plus callers from across America and Radio Graffiti to close.

item.title: Friday Night, November 6, 2026
item.description: The Friday night show, aired Saturday, November 7, 2026, 12:00–3:00 AM Eastern from DeLand, Florida. The night's real news: California commutes all 548 death sentences; Gina Hinojosa wins the Texas governor's race; the October jobs report beats forecasts; Paraguay's president removed after a bank collapse; Paul Mackenzie sentenced to 200 years in Kenya; Pope Leo XIV begins a 12-day South America tour. Plus callers from across America and Radio Graffiti to close.

item.title: Thursday Night, November 5, 2026
item.description: The Thursday night show, aired Friday, November 6, 2026, 12:00–3:00 AM Eastern from DeLand, Florida. Three hours of real State, National and International news, callers from across America and around the world, and Radio Graffiti in the final half hour.

item.title: Wednesday Night, November 4, 2026 — The Premiere
item.description: The premiere of America After Dark, aired Thursday, November 5, 2026, 12:00–3:00 AM Eastern. The night's news, all researched from real reporting: Florida's Amendment 3 property-tax fight and the planned special session; Democrats taking control of Congress in the midterm elections; and the aftermath of the deadly high-speed rail crash in Spain. Plus listener calls through the night and Radio Graffiti in the final half hour — one line per caller.
